title: из-за + genitive: from behind, because of

blocks.text: **из-за** takes the **genitive** case: from behind, because of.

items: to get up from the table

blocks.text: Meanings and examples: Wiktionary, «из-за» (en.wiktionary.org, CC BY-SA 4.0). Exercises: sentences and translations from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Из-за сплошного ___ (туман, gen. sg.) дорога плохо просматривалась.
exercises.prompt: Because of the thick fog, the road was hard to see.
exercises.why: **туман → тумана** (gen. sg.). Declines like дом. Ending — (no ending) → -а.

exercises.q: Из-за плохой ___ (погода, gen. sg.) земледельцы потеряли много урожая.
exercises.prompt: Farmers suffered crop losses from poor weather.
exercises.why: **погода → погоды** (gen. sg.). Declines like газета. Ending -а → -ы.

exercises.q: Из-за внезапной ___ (болезнь, gen. sg.) он отменил заграничную поездку.
exercises.prompt: He gave up traveling abroad because of his sudden illness.
exercises.why: **болезнь → болезни** (gen. sg.). Declines like часть. Ending -ь → -и.

exercises.q: Мои родители не любят моего парня из-за ___ (он) расы.
exercises.prompt: My parents don't like my boyfriend because of his race.
exercises.why: **его** (and «его», «их») is the same in every case and number: it does not agree with the noun it belongs to, unlike «мой», «наш». Only the noun changes with its case.

exercises.q: Сила моих мышц ослабла из-за ___ (недостаток, gen. sg.) упражнений.
exercises.prompt: My muscular strength has weakened from lack of exercise.
exercises.why: **недостаток → недостатка** (gen. sg.). Declines like дом. Ending — (no ending) → -а, with the fleeting -о- of the stem dropped: недостатк- + -а.
